scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Encouraging Worker's Children's Participation in Sports Activities- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
other_conditions: Applicant must be employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana
Applicant must be registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board
No minimum service period required for the worker
Application must be submitted within one year of the issuance of the certificate of participation in sports activities
Benefits are provided to the children of the registered workers
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance ranging from ₹2,000 to ₹31,000 for workers' children participating in sports competitions and achieving 1st, 2nd or 3rd places at district to international levels.
